outcome: Select PLM batch 336 as the measured offline operating point near 130 W. The single-process graph endpoint reached a lower CPU-package power plateau and has no valid 130 W rate.
accuracy_conclusion: On archived validation responses post-processed to 16 IDs, PLM matches the graph exact ID set on 153/222 queries (macro F1 0.8305); graph oracle is exact by construction. This is not protected-test evidence.
limitations: GPU throughput is offline batched generation plus a post-decode 16-ID cap, not online HTTP capacity.
The CPU and GPU rates are measured through different execution paths and should not be compared as a matched serving SLO.
